research_mesh.rule: Every scientific trigger ingests all connected branches before Fusion 1, scans contradictions and writes cross-links back. FRANK treats the newest Clay research/architecture as its primary foundation; Clay is the integrated master foundry.

research_orchestration.fallback_behavior: Automatically continue with the best legacy/verified fallback when quota/provider/runtime/credential limitations prevent a planned call.
research_orchestration.promotion_behavior: Each failed/blocked MUST_ATTEMPT tool requires a successful fallback explicitly covering that tool before strong promotion.

worker_provider_bridge.rule: GitHub-connected workers unable to execute repo-local provider adapters directly enqueue an allowlisted request; Actions executes it with the private credential store and writes a sanitized result.

visible_response.completion_rule: A substantive answer missing the required footer or short commands is not 100% complete.

external_research.secret_rule: By project-owner authorization, credentials may persist in the designated private-repository token store only when the active connector permits the write; values must never be copied into canonical research artifacts, reports, logs or visible responses.

limitations: no assumption of direct shell access to the live FRANK host
E2B cannot be runtime-verified until E2B_API_KEY is stored through a permitted channel
hosted Piston cannot be runtime-verified until PISTON_API_TOKEN is configured or a self-hosted PISTON_API_URL is supplied
Semantic Scholar public shared-pool requests may transiently rate-limit; use OpenAlex/arXiv/Crossref fallback
